verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the official docs listing GLTFLoader among three.js's loaders, which shows first-party glTF import. Nothing in the pack covers FBX or USD import, or how cleanly any format imports. Missing for 10: evidence of FBX import, evidence of USD import, any detail or hands-on corroboration that glTF imports cleanly (materials, animations, fidelity).

support.subject: As a technical artist, standard interchange formats — glTF, FBX, USD — import cleanly
